ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 37

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

3. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 29
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

4. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 17
   D. 15

7. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 10
   C. 100
   D. 11

8. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

9. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 1, 6
   D. 2, 4, 6

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

11. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 48
   C. 14
   D. 49

12. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9

   D. 81

13. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 26

14. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 21
   C. 20
   D. 1

15. Solve for x: x + 4 = 8. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 4
   C. 8
   D. 4

16. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 36

17. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 21
   C. 30
   D. 42

19. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 26

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22

   D. 34

21. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
